label: G.hn coax bridge (2x GbE + F-connector)
description: G.hn bridge for existing TV coax: two 100/1000BASE-T RJ45 ports and one F-connector G.hn port rated up to 500 Mbit/s PHY, with a built-in filter so DVB-C/TV signal passes through the same cable. Sold as a point-to-point pair for runs up to about 800 m.
